# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**9:1** I thank You, O Lord, for You have opened my ear to wondrous mysteries.

**9:2** And You have not closed my ear against the chastening of [...] the upheavals of the age.

**9:3** For the spirit of flesh [...] amid the deeds of wickedness and transgression.

**9:4** I have held fast to Your covenant. And the truth that [...] You have implanted in my heart.

**9:5** And Your covenant-faithfulness for the deliverance of my soul, and the steps of my feet You have made firm.

**9:6** Against the dominion of wickedness. And You have made me a snare for transgressors.

**9:7** But healing for all who turn from transgression, and discernment for the simple.

**9:8** And a steadfast resolve for all the faint of heart. You have appointed me as a reproach and derision for the treacherous.

**9:9** A counsel of truth and understanding for the upright of way.

**9:10** Against the schemes of the wicked I have become as one whom [...] reproach.

**9:11** Through me You have caused the faces of the Many to shine; You have multiplied Yourself beyond reckoning.

**9:12** For You have made known to me Your wondrous mysteries.

**9:13** And in Your wondrous secret counsel You have displayed Your might through me.

**9:14** Working wonders before the Many for the sake of Your glory.

**9:15** And making known Your mighty deeds to all the living.

**9:16** What is flesh that You should act thus toward it? And how is a creature of clay able to do great wonders?

**9:17** For it abides in iniquity from the womb, and in guilty unfaithfulness until old age.

**9:18** And I know that righteousness belongs not to a mortal, nor a blameless way to a son of man.

**9:19** To God Most High belong all deeds of righteousness, and the way of a mortal is not established.

**9:20** Except by the spirit that God fashioned for him, to make perfect a way for the children of man.

**9:21** That all His works may know the power of His might and the abundance of His mercies.

**9:22** Upon all the children of His favor.

**9:23** And trembling and dread have seized me, and all my bones have shattered.

**9:24** And my heart has melted like wax before the fire, and my knees have become as water poured upon a slope.

**9:25** For I have remembered my guilty deeds together with the faithlessness of my fathers.

**9:26** When the wicked rose against Your covenant and the depraved against Your word.

**9:27** And I said, for my transgression I have been forsaken from Your covenant.

**9:28** But when I remembered the might of Your hand together with the abundance of Your mercies.

**9:29** I rose and stood firm, and my spirit held its stand before affliction.

**9:30** For I leaned upon Your covenant-faithfulness and upon the abundance of Your compassion.

**9:31** For You atone for iniquity and purify man by Your righteousness from [...] transgression.

**9:32** Not for man's sake but for the sake of Your glory. For You have created the righteous and the wicked.

**9:33** And You have established the spirit of [...] and the design of [...] from before the ages.

**9:34** And the judgment of all and the duty of [...] You have apportioned through all their generations.

**9:35** Working wonders before the Many for the sake of Your glory and making known Your mighty deeds.

**9:36** To all the living, that all may know Your might and the abundance of Your mercies upon all the children of Your favor.

**9:37** And I, Your servant, have come to know by the spirit that You have placed in me that Your words are truth, and all Your deeds are righteousness.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Column 9 consensus blends LOGOS and EMET. Key decisions: "opened my ear" (EMET, 9:1) for biblical simplicity; "caused the faces of the Many to shine" (LOGOS, 9:11) for Aaronic blessing resonance; "the Many" preserved throughout; "held fast" (LOGOS, 9:4); "blameless" (LOGOS, 9:18); "come to know" (LOGOS, 9:37) for experiential emphasis.*
